plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mini-window **A mini-window mode for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — install it and a floating ball pops out a real, always-on-top browser window.** **给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的小窗模式插件 —— 装上就有一个悬浮球，点一下弹出真正的置顶浏览器小窗。** **Zero download · no Electron · no third-party plugins · zero impact when off.** **零额外下载 · 不需要 Electron · 不依赖任何第三方插件 · 不带参数时对主界面零影响。** [English](#english) · [中文](#中文)
--- ## English ### What it is `dsh-mini-window` gives DSH a **mini window**. Install the plugin and a **floating ball** appears in the page; click it and DSH opens in a **separate, always-on-top browser window** at 520×720 — a real OS window you can move and pin over other apps. The same layout is also reachable in-page with `?dsh-mini=1`, where the three-column UI collapses into a compact single-column view styled as a floating card. When `?dsh-mini=1` is absent, the attribute `html[data-dsh-mini]` never exists, so **every rule is inert** and the official layout is untouched. ### Features | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | **Standalone mini window** | A real browser window in **app mode**: no address bar, no tab strip, exactly 520×720. Driven via `--app=`, so **nothing is downloaded** | | **Pin on top** | Toggle always-on-top from the top bar — a real Win32 `SetWindowPos`, with the state read back to confirm | | **Floating ball** | Appears automatically (draggable, snaps to the nearest edge, remembers its position). **Pure DOM.** | | **Mini-window mode** | Open `/?dsh-mini=1` for the same compact single-column layout in-page | | **Top-bar controls** | Minimize / pin-on-top / sidebar toggle / compact float / more menu (includes 80%–150% UI zoom) | | **Does not fight the official layout** | At narrow viewports DSH already collapses the sidebar into an overlay; this plugin **deliberately does not reimplement** responsive behavior | | **Verifiable zero-impact** | With no `?dsh-mini=1` **none of the mini CSS applies** | ### What you get after installing | | | | --- | --- | | `dsh plugin --profile

add @a9i5k4/dsh-mini-window` | Floating ball **+ 520×720 always-on-top browser mini window** | | Extra download | **0 bytes** — it drives the Chrome/Edge you already have | | Requirement | **Chrome or Edge installed** (Chrome preferred, Edge as fallback) | | Not included | Tray icon. Close the mini window and click the ball again to reopen | ### Install ```bash # npm (recommended) dsh plugin --profile add @a9i5k4/dsh-mini-window # or with pnpm directly pnpm add @a9i5k4/dsh-mini-window # or from GitHub dsh plugin --profile add github:Aik358/dsh-mini-window ``` **Restart the DSH host** after installing (the plugin roster is assembled at startup). Then either: - **Click the floating ball** in the page → the 520×720 always-on-top window pops out, or - open `http://127.0.0.1:19387/?dsh-mini=1` for the in-page mini layout. - **With** `?dsh-mini=1` → mini-window mode - **Without** → official three-column layout, zero impact ### Requirements Chrome or Edge must be installed. If neither is found the plugin reports an **explicit error** instead of silently doing nothing. Override the path if needed: ```powershell $env:DSH_MINI_BROWSER = "D:\path\to\chrome.exe" ``` If `DSH_MINI_BROWSER` is set but points to a missing file, the plugin **fails explicitly** rather than falling back to the default browser, so a misconfiguration is never silently ignored. ### Design decisions **1. Why the browser, not Electron** The earliest design shipped a separate Electron process. That costs **~235 MB of downloads** and is not part of the DSH plugin contract. Since a browser window is just an OS window, the plugin instead drives **Chrome/Edge in app mode**: ``` chrome.exe --app= --window-size=520,720 --user-data-dir= ``` - App mode gives an independent window **with no address bar**. - The plugin runs a one-shot loopback service that sets a session cookie and redirects to DSH, so the mini window starts **already authenticated**. - Cookies **ignore the port**, so the handoff service and DSH can use different ports. - The isolated profile lives under `~/.dsh/dsh-mini-window-browser` — **your own browser profile is never touched.** **Trade-off, stated honestly:** app mode keeps the **system title bar** (unlike Electron's `frame:false`). Removing it entirely would mean shipping Electron again, contradicting the zero-download goal. **2. Why not write custom responsive CSS** DSH's front end is already responsive. Measured: | Viewport width | Sidebar | Conversation | | --- | --- | --- | | ≥1024 | 280px expanded | @x=280 | | 920–760 | auto-collapsed to 56px rail | @x=56 | | ≤760 | overlay, `pointer-events:none` | full width @x=0 | `elementFromPoint` hit the sidebar **0/9** times across the left strip — the official UI already gives the conversation full width. A second set of collapse rules would only fight the official mechanism, producing random symptoms. So it is deliberately not done. **3. All rules scoped under `html[data-dsh-mini]`** Without the parameter the attribute is absent ⇒ **nothing applies**. This is what makes the "zero-impact" claim verifiable rather than aspirational. **4. Single source of truth for the spec** `plugin/lib/mini-spec.cjs` holds geometry and colors. The stylesheet and the app side share one copy, so a number is never written in two places and left to drift. **5. No build step** `lib/client.js` is a hand-written classic script registered via the official `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. Verified against the real bundle — edit and refresh, no bundling. **6. Never bubble up** The host decides whether startup succeeded by whether an entry activated. Any uncaught exception makes the **entire app fail to open** — so every host-side path is wrapped in `try/catch` and degrades instead of throwing. **7. Verify window operations by reading state back** `SetWindowPos` is asynchronous across processes: reading `WS_EX_TOPMOST` immediately after setting it returns the **old** value. The plugin waits before reading back, and iterates **all** candidate windows rather than guessing one — otherwise a stale read looks exactly like a "the pin button does nothing" bug. ### Project layout ``` plugin/ ← the publishable DSH plugin package.json ← dsh.client declaration (platform / inject) lib/client.js ← browser entry (hand-written, no build) lib/index.js ← host entry lib/host-routes.js ← host routes (/dsh-mini-window/*) lib/browser-window.js ← browser app-mode window (launch / fit / pin) lib/host-window.js ← Electron window path (fallback) lib/ls-extract.cjs ← zero-dependency Chromium localStorage extractor lib/mini-spec.cjs ← single source of truth for the spec cordis.patch.yml ← host-side mount tests/smoke/ ← runtime guard companion/ ← legacy standalone Electron mini window (not published to npm) main.js ← main process (auth / injection / window / tray) preload.js renderer/ ← floating ball + window shell ``` > `companion/` is the **earlier** Electron approach. The shipped mini window no longer needs it; > it is kept in the repository for reference and costs ~151 MB if you build it. > > `evidence/` and `probe/` hold local development-time instrumentation. They depend on this > machine's DSH host and screenshots, are excluded via `.gitignore`, and are not distributed. ### Development ```bash # Runtime guard: actually executes the factory and verifies DSH can load the plugin node plugin/tests/smoke/client-factory-guard.cjs # Syntax check node --check plugin/lib/client.js ``` When installed as a local link (`link:/plugin`), a **page refresh** is enough for client changes — but **host-side** changes (`lib/index.js`, `lib/host-routes.js`, `lib/browser-window.js`) require a host restart. ### Compatibility - **Platform**: `web` (DSH desktop and web share the same front end) - **Browser**: Chrome preferred, Edge as fallback

# dsh-tianyicui-monitor

[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-109%20passing-brightgreen)](#tests)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin. It adds a
sidebar entry showing a maintainer's commit activity and a **calibrated probability that a new DSH
version ships within 72 hours**.

Reads public GitHub data only. No credentials, no telemetry.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

---

## What it does

A row in the DSH sidebar, next to Plugins / MCP, opening a report:

- **Verdict** — a gauge with the 90% threshold drawn on the arc, and a verdict band
  (`release likely` / `watch` / `quiet`)
- **Totals** — commits in the main repo, commits across all public repos, GitHub contribution count
- **Timeline** — daily commits with release markers
- **Heatmap** — GitHub-style contribution grid
- **Model timeline** — DeepSeek model launches against DSH releases
- **Contributions** — daily GitHub contribution counts, private-activity days flagged
- **Evidence** — Brier / AUC / calibration error, and the hazard bucket behind the current number

Click any day on the timeline or the heatmap: both charts highlight it and a readout shows that
day's commit counts, whether a release landed, and which version.

## How the probability is derived

### 1. Predictors

Each hour is a sample. Two features are used, both known at that moment:

- **hours since the last release**
- **day of week**

Commit volume was tested and dropped: in a 24-hour window it carries no signal (0.99× the baseline).
Whether a release is *overdue* is what matters.

### 2. Hazard × weekday

Bucketed by hours since the last release, the empirical release rate rises steadily as a cycle ages:

| Hours since last release | P(release within 72h) |
|---|---|
| 0–6 h | 74.4% |
| 30–36 h | 64.0% |
| 48–60 h | 85.7% |
| 72–96 h | 97.0% |
| 96 h+ | 100% |

There is also a strong weekday effect — the team ships midweek, not on Fridays (Thursday 95.8% vs
Friday 54.7%). The two are combined on the odds scale:

```
logit P = logit(hazard[hours-since-last-release bucket])
        + log(weekday relative risk)
```

### 3. Calibration

A monotone (isotonic) curve is fitted to the model's own out-of-sample output, so the number shown
is the observed frequency rather than a raw score.

```
P_calibrated = isotonic(P_raw)
```

### 4. Why a 72-hour window

The probability that a release lands in the next **24 hours** tops out at **77.7%** (Wilson upper
bound 87.9%), so a 90% verdict is unreachable in that window. Over 72 hours it reaches **94.0%**,
which makes 90% a real, crossable line:

| Horizon | Base rate | Best achievable | Reaches 90%? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 h | 24.4% | 54.0% | no |
| 24 h | 43.1% | 77.7% | no |
| 48 h | 63.5% | 88.8% | no |
| **72 h** | **78.8%** | **94.0%** | **yes** |

(Base rate here is the unconditional release rate over the same window used for the horizon sweep;
the calibrated model's own fitted base rate over its training window is 82.1%.)

## Validation

Rolling-origin backtesting: refit every 6 hours on data strictly before the evaluation instant,
across 1,092 out-of-sample hours.

| Model | Brier ↓ | AUC ↑ | Log loss ↓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Constant base rate | 0.1509 | 0.500 | 0.4819 |
| hazard × weekday | 0.1402 | 0.687 | 0.4451 |
| **+ isotonic calibration** | **0.1346** | **0.687** | **0.4426** |

Calibration error falls from 7.33 pp to **4.17 pp**.

The ≥90% verdict fires on 49.9% of hours and is followed by a release within 72 hours **92.7%** of
the time (Wilson 95% CI 90.2–94.6%).

> **Limitation:** the history contains only 37 independent release events, so the intervals are
> wide. The panel states this in its footer. Do not make important decisions from it.

## DeepSeek model releases

Model launches are shown as timeline context, **not** as a model input. Scoped to models published
since the DSH repository was created — including **V4-Flash-0731** and **V4-Pro-0813** — with dates
taken from Hugging Face model-card creation time.

Notable alignment: each of the three flagship launches *after* DSH's first public release was
followed by a DSH release within **0.5 days**.

| Model launch | Next DSH release |
|---|---|
| 2026-08-13 · V4-Pro-0813 | +0.2 d |
| 2026-08-31 · V4-Flash-Vision-Exp | +0.4 d |
| 2026-09-10 · V4.1-Flash | +0.5 d |

> With only three observations this is a pattern, not a measurable effect, and it is not evidence
> that a model launch *causes* a DSH release. The three earlier launches predate DSH's first release
> and cannot be compared at all. They are deliberately kept out of the probability model, both
> because n=3 cannot support a predictor and because the base rate already explains most of it.

## Install

```bash
npm test        # 109 tests
npm run build   # emits lib/client.js
```

Place the package under your DSH profile's `node_modules`, then append a loader entry to that
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tianyicui-monitor
      name: dsh-tianyicui-monitor
```

Restart DSH. `sync.sh` automates the copy:

```bash
DSH_CANON_DIR="$HOME/dsh-plugins/dsh-tianyicui-monitor" \
DSH_PROFILES="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web" \
  ./sync.sh
```

## Data sources

| What | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Commits in the main repo | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits` |
| Releases | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases` |
| Commits across all public repos | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contributors` |
| Contribution graph (includes private) | `https://github.com/users/{u}/contributions` |

An offline snapshot ships with the plugin so the panel always renders, then refreshes live.
Unauthenticated GitHub allows 60 requests/hour; the panel shows a countdown when that runs out.

Two notes on reading this data:

- **Unreadable is not zero.** `GET /user/repos` returns **401** unauthenticated, so private
  repositories cannot be counted. The panel reports `private repos visible: 0` and says why.
- **The contribution graph counts "contributions"** (commits + PRs + issues + reviews), **not
  commits**, so it is shown as a separate row and never summed with the commit totals. Its daily
  numbers do include private activity, because the account enables "include private contributions on
  my profile". GitHub returns only the count, never the repository.

A true commit count including private repos needs an authenticated GraphQL query
(`contributionsCollection.totalCommitContributions`).

## Tests

```bash
npm test
```

109 tests. `test/render.test.mjs` evaluates the built bundle and executes every component body
against real data; `test/contributions.test.mjs` parses a real captured page and asserts its daily
sum matches the total GitHub prints; `test/core.test.mjs` covers the analysis core and re-verifies
the model's own claims.

## Rebuilding the data

```bash
git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --shallow-since=2026-04-01 \
  --single-branch --branch master \
  https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git build/dsh-git

npm run data            # extract -> refit -> bundle
npm run repos           # per-repo commit scan
npm run contributions   # contribution graph
```

Every number above is reproducible with `node build/evaluate3.mjs` and
`node build/evaluate4.mjs`.

## Disclaimer

Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or by `tianyicui`. It reads public GitHub data about a
public account. All trademarks belong to their owners.

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip naming the model and reasoning effort each Session runs on, a subagent dropdown marking which child carries its own route, and sidebar hover cards showing what each conversation did.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-subagents-model

See which model a DeepSeek Harness session is really running on. A chip in the header names the model and reasoning effort of whichever conversation is open — including a subagent's — a chip in the composer dock below the composer shows which models a whole run delegated to, and sidebar hover cards say what each conversation actually did. It only ever ADDS controls: the harness's own subagent dropdown is left exactly as shipped.

## Install From the GUI, paste this into **Add plugin**: ``` dsh-subagents-model ``` Or from a terminal: ```bash dsh plugin add dsh-subagents-model ``` **No build step is involved** and there are no dependencies at all. Every entry point ships as committed source: the Host reads `src/client.js` and serves it to the page verbatim, so pnpm never has to run anything and you are never asked to allowlist a build. **Nothing else is required.** The installer does the composition work itself — it reads this package's `cordis.patch.yml`, mounts the Loader row, and adds the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` (`dsh-plugin-manager/lib/index.js:247-265`). Do **not** hand-add a row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` or the package to `package.json`: a second definition of the same package fails composition and takes the whole web shell with it (`dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js:871-877`). Restart the profile afterwards. The header chip appears in any conversation that has made a request; the bottom-bar chip appears only once a run has delegated to at least one subagent, because a run with no subagents has nothing to say. The peer range on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`) is the only compatibility field the runtime evaluates (`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:289-301`): a plugin whose range does not satisfy the running runtime is skipped at boot with a warning naming the mismatch.
Installing by other routes | Route | Command | | --- | --- | | npm, the default | `dsh plugin add dsh-subagents-model` | | Pinned to a version | `dsh plugin add dsh-subagents-model@1.2.1` | | Pinned to a commit | `dsh plugin add github:mirelconstantin/dsh-subagents-model#` | | Tarball | `dsh plugin add ./dsh-subagents-model-1.2.1.tgz` | | Local checkout | `dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-subagents-model` | A `file:` or local-path install hard-links the package directory, so an editor that replaces a file breaks the link and the profile silently keeps the previous content. After editing a local install, delete `profiles//node_modules/dsh-subagents-model` and re-install.
## If nothing appears Every failure mode this plugin has had was silent — no error, no log, just an absent chip — so here is the order to check: 1. **Restart the profile.** The bundle is composed at boot, not on save. 2. **Confirm it is enabled** in Settings → Plugins. 3. **Run the suite in the installed copy.** It needs no harness and no network: `npm test` from the package directory prints 89 unit tests, 35 composition checks, and an install probe that packs the tarball, unpacks it into a throwaway profile and executes the shipped bytes. A failure names the layer. 4. **The header chip is the diagnostic.** It renders in any conversation with a resolved route and needs no subagents. If the header chip is missing but the dock chip is present, the dock's session-scope slot is the problem; if both are missing, the browser half did not load at all. Contributors: [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) and [RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md). ## What it shows | seat | what it shows | where | | --- | --- | --- | | **header chip** | `model: (effort)` for the **active** Session | beside the subagent pill in the conversation header | | **bottom-bar chip** | how many subagents this run delegated to, and which models they ran on | `conversation.composer.dock`, below the composer beside the ContextMeter | | **hover-card rows** | model, effort, work done, active time, tokens, cache, context window, task, kind | inside every Session's hover card in the sidebar | The chip's tooltip also names the reasoning efforts a model offers and which one is its default, read from the live model catalog. A model the catalog does not list adds nothing: the catalog is advisory and routing accepts ids it does not advertise, so its absence is never treated as a fault. The effort appears only when one is set — it is optional on the same route record the model comes from, and a session with none configured stays compact. Presentation only. The model, its tools, and its session log are untouched: no tool is registered, no service is published, and nothing the model can observe changes. ## The problem it solves DeepSeek Harness routes a session by model, and a subagent may run a *different* one than its parent — but nothing on the page said so. Two things follow: **A subagent's model was invisible until you opened it.** Session projections reach the browser in two places, and they hold different sessions. `projectionsBySession` only carries a session whose projection store is *resident* in the client, and stores are created lazily (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js:2525`) — so a subagent the user never opened was simply absent. The list rows carry the same values under `byId[id].projectionValues` (`:2942`, `:3521`, `:3549`), synthesized from the parent's `subagentCatalog` (`:3518-3542`), which is what covers a child that is listed but never loaded. Reading both sources is the whole fix. **An inherited route was unrecoverable.** With model selection off — the `subagent` default (`dsh-tool-subagent/README.md:47`) — every child inherits its parent's route (`:67`), and that route is nowhere in the child's own log. The plugin walks `parentId` up the lineage until an ancestor records an explicit one, so an opened subagent names a real model marked `(inherited)` rather than nothing. ## Where the value comes from The `modelSelection` Session projection, which the harness already registers and already ships to the browser: ``` dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/model-selection-projection.js stateSchema : { lastUsed, pending } (routes carry optional reasoningEffort) wire view : { lastUsed, next } // next = pending ?? lastUsed registered : lib/index.js:2114 (installModelSelectionProjection) ``` `lastUsed` is folded from each request's own `request/header` config, so it is the route the session **actually** used, not the one it was configured with. `next` is the pending selection while one is queued and `lastUsed` otherwise, so reading `next` answers "which model is this session on" in both states. That is the same read the shipped Agent Team row performs (`dsh-experimental-client-ui-agent-team/lib/client.js:89`). ## Subagents, honestly Model selection is off by default, so a subagent reading `Inherited from parent` is the **expected case, not a bug** — nothing was overridden. What differs by construction: - **A continuable subagent with its own route** snapshots `agentProvider` / `agentModel` / `agentReasoningEffort` in its descriptor (`dsh-subagent/lib/types/descriptor.js:38-45`), so its explicit model is recovered and shown in full. - **A one-shot subagent with its own route** deliberately omits the agent route (`:37`, `:118-126`) because cold resume does not need it. An explicitly selected one-shot model is therefore not durable, and the plugin says `Inherited from parent` rather than guessing. That is a limi

# dsh-task-gantt

**An agent-team task Gantt chart for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar** — one swimlane per teammate on the y-axis, real session time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

> **Screenshot below is the real panel rendered from a synthetic fixture**
> (5 lanes with 5 different agent colours, tasks of clearly different durations,
> one still running, message arrows in both directions), captured from a real
> browser at 2× and cropped to the panel itself: `docs/screenshots/panel-v4.png`.
> It is labelled as such on purpose: the drawing is the shipped component, but the
> DATA is a fixture, so it is not a real-team capture. The footer in the image
> carries the build identity (`v0.2.11 · label-in-box`), which is how a reader can
> tell which build drew it.
> The remaining shots (board overview from real team data, task-card detail,
> degraded state) are still pending; see
> [`docs/SCREENSHOTS.md`](docs/SCREENSHOTS.md). No mock-ups will be published.

![The task Gantt panel in the dark skin: five lanes with different agent colours,
message arrows pointing out or in, and task bars whose length is the task's real
duration, with the title drawn inside each bar](docs/screenshots/panel-v4.png)

`dsh-task-gantt` is a plugin for [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/ChuanTianML/dsh-better-sidebar): it registers one extra sidebar tab. It is **read-only** — it never creates, claims, or completes a task.

---

## Project status

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `0.2.31` |
| Frozen contract (`src/shared/contract.ts`) | done |
| Host data layer (`src/host/**`) | in progress |
| Sidebar tab registration (`src/client/index.ts`) | done |
| Gantt rendering (`src/client/ui/**`) | in progress |
| Real-machine mount smoke test | not run yet |

The chart is described below **as specified by the frozen contract**; for what has
actually been executed and observed, read
[`docs/VALIDATION.md`](docs/VALIDATION.md) (owned by the verification teammate) —
this README does not restate untested claims as results.

## What you get

- **Swimlanes = the roster.** The Lead first, then the teammates in roster order,
  then an `unassigned` row for tasks the board has not handed to anyone.
- **A real time axis.** Every span and every task transition is dated from the
  durable session event log (epoch ms) — not from "when the panel happened to
  open".
- **Turn bands with step bars inside.** A whole prompt/response turn is a faint
  band; each model step inside it is a solid bar. A span that has not closed yet
  is drawn open-ended and extends toward now.
- **Task chips carry the work, not just a colour.** `subject` plus a one-line
  `description`, with status, owner, `blockedBy`, `writeScopes` and readiness in
  the detail view.
- **Honest degradation.** When a lane cannot be dated, the panel says so and
  labels the task as live instead of inventing an interval.
- **Themed by tokens, bilingual by default.** All colour comes from DSH's
  `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-font-*` / `--ds-*` tokens, so every skin works; the UI
  is Chinese or English depending on the page language.

## Requirements

| Requirement | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.0-rc.2` (the version this plugin was developed against) |
| dsh-better-sidebar | `>= 0.4.0` (the release that introduced the `ctx.betterSidebar` registry service) |
| Node | `>= 20` |
| Profile | any browser-backed DSH Web profile |

The plugin declares one peer, `@deepseek-ai/cordis@^4.0.0`, and marks it
optional. It declares **no** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer on purpose: the host's
startup compatibility preflight evaluates those ranges and silently disables the
whole profile row when one fails. See [`docs/DESIGN.md`](docs/DESIGN.md) §8.

If `dsh-better-sidebar` is not installed, the plugin still loads and logs one
warning; it simply has no tab to register into.

## Install

The commands below are quoted **verbatim** from
[`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md) (owner: packaging), which is the single
place they are written down and carries the full evidence for each one.

```bash
cd ~/.dsh && dsh plugin --profile web add "github:xx529/dsh-task-gantt"
```

Then restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh the browser page (`Cmd+Shift+R`).

> **Status: `[not run]`.** `xx529/dsh-task-gantt` does not exist on GitHub yet
> (`gh repo view xx529/dsh-task-gantt` → *"Could not resolve to a Repository"*),
> so this exact command cannot be run end-to-end today. It is written from
> first-hand sources, not from memory: `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments
> verbatim to `pnpm` (`~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.2/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js:96`),
> and `github:owner/repo` is the form the official docs print for a bundle
> plugin ([`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md) §1.1, with the same form verified
> against a real package).

> ### ⚠️ Do not install it under an alias
>
> `… add "dsh-task-gantt@github:xx529/dsh-task-gantt"` also parses, but it lands
> the package at `node_modules/<alias>` while its inner `package.json` still says
> `"name": "dsh-task-gantt"`. The profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list and the
> Loader row are keyed by the **package name**, so the mismatch degrades to
> "warn, then skip". Use the unaliased form above
> ([`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md) §1.1).

Optional prerequisite: the panel needs **dsh-better-sidebar** to have somewhere
to register. It is deliberately not a dependency of this package.

```bash
cd ~/.dsh && dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar
```

## Uninstall

```bash
cd ~/.dsh && dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-task-gantt
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards.

> ⚠️ **`remove` does not rewrite the patch layer.** Uninstalling deletes the
> dependency but does not remove manually-added `insert` lines from a
> `cordis.patch.yml`. This package's row comes from its own bundle patch
> (`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`), which leaves with the package, so
> nothing should be left behind — but if you had also hand-added an
> `- insert: - id: dsh-task-gantt` line to
> `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, delete that line too
> ([`docs/INSTALL.md`](docs/INSTALL.md) §5).

## Usage

### Opening the panel

1. Open a session that has an agent team (a Lead session with teammates or at
   least one shared task).
2. Open the **right sidebar** and click **`+`**.
3. Pick the tab:
   - Chinese UI: **任务甘特图**
   - English UI: **Task Gantt**

The tab is declared `single: true` — the documented single-instance sugar
(`single: true` ≡ `dedupeKey: () => id`): reopening it focuses the existing tab
instead of stacking a second one. If your sidebar shows no description next to
the entry, that is a host-side rule, not a plugin bug — the host only renders
descriptions while the new-tab list holds 4 or fewer entries.

### Reading the chart

| Element | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Lane header | one roster member: name, role, and a status dot |
| Faint band | a whole turn (`turn/start` … settlement) |
| Solid bar | one model step inside a turn (`step/start` … `step/end`) |
| Open-ended bar | the span has not closed yet — it extends toward "now" |
| Vertical "now" line | the current wall-clock time |
| Task chip | a shared task, positioned by its dated history |
| Task chip with a live marker | the task has no dated history; its position is its *current* state, not a recorded interval |

Hover or focus a task chip for the full `subject`, `description`, `blockedBy`,
`writeScopes`, and whether it is `ready`. The chart is built from real DOM
elements rather than a canvas, so it is selectable text and screen-reader
reachable.

### Degraded states

The panel always tells you how its timeline was assembled. The response carries a
`source` field with exactly three values:

| `source` | What it means | What you see |
|---|---|---|
| `log` | spans came from readable durable session logs — authoritative | full timeline |
| `partial` | some lanes' logs were unreadable | the readable lanes are drawn; the others degrade, with a note |
| `live` | no log was readable — the board is projection-only | current state only, clearly labelled, w

plugins.description: 头歌（EduCoder）作业自动化 DSH 插件：全量扫描未完成作业并一次做完。选择题零 token（平台在提交响应里回吐答案键），只有代码题调用模型。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-educoder

**头歌（EduCoder）作业自动化** — 一个 DSH 插件：全量扫描账号里所有未完成的作业，然后一次做完。

没有浏览器自动化，没有截图识别，没有 OCR：每一步都是平台自己的 JSON 接口。

## 低 token 是怎么做到的

这是本插件最核心的设计，分三层：

1. **扫描不花 token。** 一门课的作业列表本身就带每份作业的「已通过关卡数 / 总关卡数」，
   所以**已完成的作业直接跳过，一个关卡都不读**。实测账号：8 门课、112 份作业，
   全量扫描 **9.4 秒、0 token**。
2. **选择题不花 token。** 头歌并不在关卡数据里公布答案（本账号所有选择题的
   `standard_answer` 都是 null，包括一份 172 题的期末复习）。但**平台会在任意一次提交的
   响应里回吐每道题的标准答案**。所以做法是：提交一次探针答案 → 从响应收割答案键 →
   再提交正确答案。全程不需要模型，也不需要猜。
3. **只有代码题才调模型。** 生成源码文件必须用模型，这是唯一无法避免的 token 成本。
   而且已经通过的关卡不会被重新生成。

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `educoder_sweep` | **推荐入口。** 扫描整个账号（或指定一门课），找出所有还有未通过关卡的作业。`mode=scan`（默认）只读不提交、**零 token**；`mode=solve` 真正做完，选择题零 token、代码题调模型。 |
| `educoder_homework` | 单份作业。参数 `url`（作业链接或 `homework_common_id`）；`mode=solve`（默认）真正做完，`mode=survey` 只巡检不提交。 |
| `educoder_account` | 检查账号连接状态并列出课程。可选参数 `url`：传了会真读一次该关卡，那才是会话有效的证据（只列课程不算）。登录/权限报错时用它定位问题。 |

`educoder_homework` 的 `url` 接受这几种写法：

```
https://www.educoder.net/tasks/AGUY4O7A/4197532/op7hwrazem5u   ← 浏览器里直接复制的
https://www.educoder.net/tasks/4197532/op7hwrazem5u
https://www.educoder.net/tasks/op7hwrazem5u
https://www.educoder.net/tasks/AGUY4O7A/4197532                ← 只有作业、没有具体关卡
4197532                                                        ← 纯 homework_common_id
```

日常用法就是一句：

```
你：还有哪些作业没做？          → educoder_sweep  mode=scan   （零 token）
你：都做了吧                    → educoder_sweep  mode=solve
```

## 配置

写在 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，也可以在插件设置界面改：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `login` / `password` | 空 | 头歌账号。首次登录后只复用会话 cookie，密码不会出现在对话里。 |
| `sessionFile` | `~/.educoder/session.json` | 会话缓存路径，与 `educoder-lab` CLI **共享**：那边登录过，这边直接可用。 |
| `provider` / `model` | 空 | 生成答案用的模型；留空用当前会话正在用的模型。 |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | 每道代码题最多重试几次。 |
| `maxTokens` | 8000 | 单次生成上限。 |
| `gradeTimeoutSec` | 180 | 单次评测最长等待。 |
| `pollIntervalSec` | 3 | 轮询评测结果的间隔。 |
| `challengeLimit` | 0 | 单份作业里 0 = 一次做完所有未通过关卡。 |
| `homeworkLimit` | 0 | 单次全量扫描最多处理几份作业；0 = 不限。 |
| `toolTimeoutMinutes` | 45 | 工具整体超时。 |

## 关键实现要点

这些行为来自对平台的实测，不是猜的：

- **签名**：每个请求带 `X-EDU-Type/Timestamp/Signature`，签名是
  `md5(base64("method=<M>&ak=<AK>&sk=<SK>&time=<epoch-ms>"))`。
  `AK`/`SK` 是头歌自己前端 bundle 里的**公开客户端常量**，不是用户密钥。
- **关卡遍历**：平台没有「给我第 N 关」的接口，只能靠 `prev_game`/`next_game` 走；
  而 `shixun_exec.json` 返回的是**最后访问**的关卡，不是第一关没过的。
  所以先沿 `prev_game` 回退到头，再向前走；并且**通过一关之后重新读它**，
  因为 `next_game` 在上一关通过前一直是 null。
- **一次评测**：一个关卡的多个文件是整体评测的。所以上传时 `evaluate: 0`，
  全部文件传完再触发**一次** `game_build.json` —— 每个文件触发一次会评测到半成品工作区，白烧评测配额。
- **评测判定**：`test_sets` 里有 `result: null` 时表示评测还在跑，看到 `test_sets` 就当作结论是错的。
  判定要等 `game.evaluate_count` 真的涨了（确认新一轮跑起来了），再等两次轮询结果一致；
  `game.status == 2` 直接算通过。
- **占位符**：平台填空是一串 `—`（U+2014），不是合法代码。答案里还留着它就直接本地重试，
  不浪费一次评测。
- **失败反馈**：不截断两边输出，而是定位**第一处差异**（行/列 + 上下文），
  这样反馈既短又足以让模型改对。
- **会话失效藏在 HTTP 200 里**：平台用 `{"status":401}` 表达「请登录」，
  而 HTTP 状态码是 200，只看状态码永远发现不了。检测到就自动用配置的账号重登一次再重试，
  且这发生在任何写入之前，不会重复提交。
- **`/courses.json` 不是鉴权接口**：没有会话也返回课程列表，所以它**不能**用来验证凭据；
  只有读一次关卡才算证据。插件的会话校验因此放在第一次关卡读取上。

## 安装

包名 `dsh-educoder`，bundle 行 id 是 `educoder`。

```bash
# npm（推荐，预构建安装还能跳过构建授权）
#   target: dsh-educoder
# 从 GitHub 装：
#   target: github:isheng-eqi/dsh-educoder
# 从本地目录装：
#   target: <本目录绝对路径>
```

三种方式装的是同一份代码。npm 上的是 [`dsh-educoder`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-educoder)，
发布包只含 12 个文件（`index.js`、`lib/`、`tests/`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`、
`cordis.patch.yml`、`README`、`LICENSE`），不含 `node_modules`。

装好后 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 里会出现 `educoder` 这一行，
在它的 `config` 下填 `login` / `password` 即可 —— **config 是热应用的，不用重启**。

配置改完后可以直接自检：

```
educoder_account  url: <你的作业链接>
```

它会真读一次该关卡；能读到就说明会话有效（只列课程不算证据，见下）。
只想看不提交就用 `educoder_homework` 的 `mode: "survey"`。

### 发给别人用

对方只需要有 DSH 和一台能联网的机器，三步：

1. **装** —— DSH 里 `plugin_manager`，`action: install_bundle`，
   `target: dsh-educoder`（npm）或 `target: github:isheng-eqi/dsh-educoder`（GitHub）。
   两者都是公开的，不需要任何凭据。包名是新的，首次加载直接生效，**不用重启**。
2. **填自己的账号** —— 设置界面里这个插件的配置卡片，或 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。
   填的是使用者自己的头歌账号；插件驱动的就是配置里那个账号。
3. **说一句话** —— 「还有哪些作业没做」（`educoder_sweep mode=scan`，零 token），
   或「都做了吧」（`mode=solve`）。

不需要 Python、不需要浏览器扩展、不需要任何第三方密钥：

- 仓库里**没有** `node_modules`，唯一的外部依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`
  由 DSH 安装本身提供 —— profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 固定写着 `nodeLinker: hoisted`，
  依赖是扁平摊在 `<profile>/node_modules` 里的，任何插件都能沿目录向上解析到。
  （已实测：把公开发布版 clone 到一个全新的空目录、再按 pnpm 的布局放好，
  `import('./index.js')` 直接成功，`schemastery` 从 profile 解析到。）
- 会话缓存写在 `~/.educoder/session.json`（0600），只有首次需要账号密码。

⚠️ 它会**真实提交**到平台并消耗评测次数，驱动的是配置里那个账号——给别人之前请让对方知道这一点。

### 两个平台事实（实测）

- **`/courses.json` 不需要登录也返回数据**，所以「能列出课程」不能证明凭据有效；
  只有读一次关卡才是证据。插件的会话校验因此放在第一次关卡读取上。
- **会话失效是藏在 HTTP 200 的 body 里的**（`{"status":401,...}`），
  只看 HTTP 状态码发现不了。插件检测到这个 code 就会自动用配置的账号重登一次再重试，
  而且这发生在任何写入之前，不会重复提交。

### 改了 Host 侧代码必须重启

DSH 按**包名**缓存已加载的插件模块，同一个进程内不会重新 `import` 同名包 ——
实测禁用/启用、换目录、甚至 `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle` 都拿不到新的 JS
（栈里的路径会一直指向第一次加载的位置）。

所以：

- 改 `index.js` / `lib/*.js` → **必须重启 `dsh web`**；
- 只改 `config`（账号密码、重试次数等）→ 不用重启，profile patch 由 HMR 热应用。

同理，如果插件**第一次**加载就报错，后面的修改不会自愈，重启即可。
想不重启就换代码，只有改包名一条路（会变成另一个包）—— 这也是本包从
`dsh-plugin-educoder` 改名成 `dsh-educoder` 的原因之一，顺带更贴合生态命名习惯。

## 测试

两个套件都**不联网、不消耗评测次数**：

```bash
cd "$DSH_PROFILE_DIR"           # 让 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 能被解析
node <本目录>/tests/smoke.test.mjs
node <本目录>/tests/solve-loop.test.mjs
```

- **`smoke.test.mjs`（63 项）**：工具注册走的是 DSH **真实的**
  `assertSupportedJsonSchema`（第一版就是死在这上面）；另外覆盖传输层
  （body 401 / -102 / Set-Cookie 取会话）、URL 解析、签名、以及在 mock 平台上的
  整份作业遍历与会话恢复。
- **`solve-loop.test.mjs`（65 项）**：用脚本化的模型 + mock 平台把解题循环钉死 ——
  上传与评测的**报文形状**、"多文件只触发一次评测"、占位符答案不浪费评测次数、
  重试时反馈里带了什么、重试耗尽、缺环境时拒绝半提交、中途失败保留已完成结果、
  输出被 `maxTokens` 截断时的提示、**选择题零 token 收割**（并断言全程不碰模型）、
  以及 **scan 绝不提交**。

## 安全性

- `mode=solve` 会**真实提交**到平台并消耗评测次数；不确定时先用 `mode=survey` 巡检。
- 驱动的是你自己的账号，请不要指向别人的账号。
- 会话缓存以 `0600` 权限写入，和密码一样只落在本机。
- `AK`/`SK` 是平台公开常量；这里没有、也不需要任何第三方密钥。

## 许可

MIT。这是一个非官方自动化客户端，请在自己的账号上、按头歌平台条款使用。

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 桌面端内嵌 chat.deepseek.com：双入口聊天面板（中央主面板 + 右侧栏标签页）、多桌面宿主自适应驱动、持久登录会话，零运行时依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-chat-embed

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![DSH Compatibility](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-v0.2.x-green.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Electron%20%7C%20Tauri%20v2%20(DSH%20Dock)-orange.svg)](#-多桌面客户端适配架构desktopguestadapter-策略模式)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tests-89%2F89%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](#-开发与测试自动化门禁)

为 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 打造的专业级跨桌面端 DeepSeek 聊天无缝嵌入插件。在保持 DSH 本地 AI 编程工作流的同时，将官方 `chat.deepseek.com` 深度融合至桌面端，提供沉浸式全屏对话与右侧边栏并排协同两种工作形态。

---

## 📸 运行效果截图

### 1. 右侧栏协同对话模式（边写代码 / 跑终端边即时查阅）
点击顶部导航常驻按钮，在右侧边栏以原生 Tab 并排打开 DeepSeek Chat：
![右侧栏并排协同模式](assets/screenshot-dock-chat.png)

### 2. 中央主面板沉浸式模式（大模型深度规划 / 全屏对话）
点击左侧导航栏的 `💬 聊天` 图标，在中央主工作区沉浸式全屏呈现：
![中央主面板沉浸式模式](assets/screenshot-main-panel.png)

---

## ✨ 核心特性

* 🌓 **双入口架构 (Dual-Entry Design)**：
  * **入口 ①（左侧导航主面板）**：在中央会话区域沉浸式展开 DeepSeek 网页，适合专注向大模型进行长篇咨询或规划；
  * **入口 ②（右上角常驻按钮）**：在右侧栏以原生 Tab 形式呈现，与左侧的代码编辑、文件列表或运行终端并排展示，边写代码边即时查阅。
* 🏛️ **多桌面客户端适配驱动 (DesktopGuestAdapter)**：
  * 采用设计模式中的**策略模式 (Strategy Pattern)**，统一抽象 `DesktopGuestAdapter` 接口；
  * 完美适配 **DSH 官方桌面版 (Electron)** 与 **DSH Dock (Tauri v2)**，上层业务协调器零平台硬编码侵入。
* 🔄 **客页 ↔ 宿主侧栏双向互斥与平滑折叠**：
  * **0ms 即时捕获**：在客页端通过捕获阶段监听展开事件，按下按钮的第一毫秒即向宿主通信，展开客页会话列表与收起 DSH 侧边栏同帧启动；
  * **CSS 同轨线性插值**：采用 DSH 原生缓动变量（`--ds-transition-duration-slow`），完全消除垂直跳动与水平拉扯。
* 🛡️ **非侵入式启发式 DOM 适配**：
  * 对 `chat.deepseek.com` 的 DOM 节点采用结构与语义启发式查找，不写死任何动态生成的混淆类名，抵抗前端站点迭代；
  * 内置针对 WebKit / Chromium 的尺寸抖动防护（Storm Protection），避免终端高频刷屏时触发过载重绘。
* 🔒 **高并发网络隔离保护**：
  * 遥测诊断通道采用显式短连接管理（`Connection: close`）与超时自动熔断（`AbortSignal.timeout`），杜绝 WebKit 6 个 TCP 连接池耗尽导致的页面卡死与终端空白。

---

## 🏛️ 多桌面客户端适配架构（DesktopGuestAdapter 策略模式）

由于 `chat.deepseek.com` 启用了最高等级的同源安全策略 `frame-ancestors 'none'`，普通浏览器 iframe 方案必然被网络层拒绝拦截。插件构建了统一的驱动分发层，针对不同宿主提供最适合的原生解决方案：

```
                           ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                           │         EmbeddedChat          │  (UI 宿主协调器)
                           │   - Overlay DOM 节点与测量    │  · 负责布局互斥与动画
                           │   - 状态广播 / ResizeObserver  │  · 不感知任何底层 IPC
                           └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                           │
                                  持有统一 Handle 抽象
                                           │
                                           ▼
                           ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                           │      DesktopGuestAdapter      │  (统一策略契约)
                           │  - isAvailable(): bool        │
                           │  - mount(options): Handle     │
                           │  - syncGeometry(rect, frame)  │
                           │  - setVisible(bool)           │
                           └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                           │
                   ┌───────────────────────┼───────────────────────┐
                   ▼                       ▼                       ▼
       ┌───────────────────────┐ ┌───────────────────┐ ┌───────────────────────┐
       │ ElectronGuestAdapter  │ │ TauriGuestAdapter │ │CustomNativeGuestAdapter│
       │ (DOM <webview>+Lease) │ │(Native Webview IPC)│ │(window.__DSH_CHAT_..)  │
       └───────────────────────┘ └───────────────────┘ └───────────────────────┘
```

### 1. 官方 DSH 桌面版驱动 (`ElectronGuestAdapter`)
* **运行机制**：通过调用主世界注入的 `window.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(WORKSPACE_KEY)` 申请桌面租约；
* **挂载形式**：在 DOM 树中挂载独立的 Chromium `<webview>` 标签；
* **登录态持久化**：使用专有的 `WORKSPACE_KEY` 绑定隔离分区（Partition），登录凭证随工作区持久化保存；
* **几何适配**：DOM 节点随 Overlay CSS 容器自动流动排版，无需外部原生窗口调整。

### 2. DSH Dock 客户端驱动 (`TauriGuestAdapter`)
* **运行机制**：自动检测 `window.__TAURI__` 与 `window.__DSH_PLATFORM__`；
* **原生子视窗 (Native Child Webview)**：将 `chat.deepseek.com` 作为操作系统顶层原生 Webview（WebKit / WebView2）动态挂载到主窗口之上（dsh-dock ADR-0033）；
* **标题栏差值动态补偿**：自动上报 `pageFrame()` 视口尺寸，Rust 宿主计算窗口物理像素与页面 CSS 像素的差值（排除标题栏红绿灯偏移），消除 32px 遮挡；
* **受限安全双向通信通道**：宿主 → 客页走本地校验的 `embed_chat_eval`，客页 → 宿主通过带有校验前缀的通道回传，请求异步串行化配对；
* **优雅降级**：若运行在未提供原生子视窗的旧版 Tauri 环境中，自动平滑降级为「伴侣卡片」引导模式。

### 3. 通用原生多视窗协议 (`CustomNativeGuestAdapter`)
支持任意第三方桌面壳（Wails、Qt、CEF、Flutter 等）通过实现标准接口接入：
```javascript
window.__DSH_CHAT_EMBED__ = {
  open: async ({ url, rect }) => { /* 创建/展示原生子 Webview 并定位 */ },
  hide: () => { /* 隐藏原生子 Webview */ },
  resize: ({ rect }) => { /* 调整原生子 Webview 几何大小 */ },
  close: () => { /* 销毁原生子 Webview */ },
  eval: async (code) => { /* 在子视窗中执行脚本并返回结果 */ }
}
```

---

## 📦 安装与配置

本项目原生支持 **GitHub 仓库一键安装** 与 **本地源码安装**。构建产物 `dist/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed.bundle.js` **随仓库提交**，`package.json` 不含任何安装期构建钩子（`prepare` 已于 v0.1.1 移除）——因此 git 安装不会触发 pnpm 的构建脚本审批，消费者侧零构建、零运行时依赖。

---

### 方式 1：官方桌面客户端图形界面安装（推荐，零命令行）

DSH 官方桌面版内置插件管理器，可直接粘贴 GitHub 仓库地址完成安装：

1. 打开左侧导航的 **设置 → 插件**；
2. 点击页面右上角的 **＋ 添加插件**；
3. 在输入框中填入 GitHub 仓库地址：

   ```
   github:realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
   ```

4. 按需选择**安装源**（国内网络环境可选「中国大陆镜像源」）；
5. 阅读安全提示后点击 **安装**；
6. 安装完成后**重启客户端**生效。

![官方桌面客户端图形化安装](assets/install-desktop-add-plugin.png)

> ⚠️ **安全提示**：插件在本机以你的权限运行。请仅安装来源可信的插件；来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。插件安装后暂不支持自动更新，升级需先卸载再安装新版。

---

### 方式 2：命令行安装（DSH Dock / 自定义 Profile）

```bash
# 安装到当前活动的 Profile
dsh plugin add github:realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed

# 安装到 Web Profile（适用于 DSH Dock 及 Web 端）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed

# 安装到官方桌面版 Desktop Profile（Electron）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
```

若你在自定义的 DSH Profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/`）下手动管理依赖：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add github:realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
```

> 通过 `pnpm add` 安装时，需在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中补充 `"dsh-deepseek-chat-embed"`，重启 DSH 即可使用。

---

### 方式 3：从源码本地安装（开发者）

```bash
# 1. 克隆代码仓库
git clone https://github.com/realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed.git
cd dsh-deepseek-chat-embed

# 2. 编译打包 Client Bundle
npm run build

# 3. 本地链接到目标 Profile
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
```

---

## 🧭 双入口设计规范与排版逻辑

| 入口编号 | 入口位置 | 触发行为 | 布局特性 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **入口 ①** | 左侧导航栏「自动化任务」下方的 `聊天` 图标 | 在**中央主工作区**展示全屏面板 | 自动预留顶部 `--dsh-frame-top-clearance` 避让窗口红绿灯，支持窗口拖拽 |
| **入口 ②** | 会话右上角、原生右侧栏展开按钮旁的图标 | 在**右侧边栏**中打开独立标签页 | 严格作为右边栏的一个 Tab，绝不擅自改变中央列，方便与代码并排对比 |

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：切面（facet）—— /visualize 一个名字或 arXiv 链接，主 agent 调研 + 双子代理并行生成 2D/3D 架构图谱，浮窗直接弹出 | A name or paper in, structured diagram windows out
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-facet

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：**切面 —— 任意内容进，结构化图谱出。**
> 在对话里输入 `/visualize <模型名 | arXiv 链接 | 一句话需求>`，主 agent 自动调研、
> 定「生成计划」（模式 + 视图清单），为每个视图派一个独立子代理并行画出图谱，
> 窗口直接在界面上弹出。

## 特点

- **一句话 → 一组图谱**：模型架构 / RL·Agent 训练管线 / 攻防·红蓝关系 / 论文工作流……
  自动识别内容类型并选模板；都不像时先用通用兜底（generic），必要时还能按规范**现场"造"一个新模式**（存起来，下次同类内容自动复用——框架自己长大）。
- **视图词表（文件名即约定）**：`diagram`（2D 结构图）/ `tower`（3D 层塔）/ `network`（3D 关系网络）/ `flow`（流程管线）/ `timeline`（时间线）。
  渲染层封闭（视图只有这几种 + 固定色板，风格永不崩），语义层开放（模式可生长）。
- **浮窗自动弹出**：产物就绪经 SSE 通知界面——桌面 1 视图=单窗、2 视图=双窗并排、≥3 视图=标签栏；手机单窗多标签。窗口可拖动/最大化/刷新/关闭。
- **风格铁律（视觉一致性）**：固定 10 色色板（hex 单源）；低置信字段＝虚线 + `?`；非标准/自研要素＝加粗描边 + `★`；页脚含来源——同一个插件画出来的图长得像一家人。
- **可分享的产物**：所有视图都是**单文件 HTML**（2D 类内联 SVG 零依赖；3D 类引 jsdelivr CDN 的 three.js，手机浏览器直接能转能缩）。
- **复核友好**：回复里只有一行人类摘要（不贴 JSON）；全量 `spec.json` 静默落盘，随查随看。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://codeload.github.com/wobenshiwomu/dsh-facet/tar.gz/v0.2.0'
```

或在图形界面：侧栏「插件」→ 添加插件 → 填上面这条 URL。装完重启 DSH 生效。
URL 末段的 `v0.2.0` 是版本标签；升级时换成本仓库的新版本标签重装即可。

## 使用

在任意对话里输入（名字、论文链接、或者一句大白话都行）：

```
/visualize Qwen3-0.6B
/visualize https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.21783
/visualize 把 GRPO 的训练流程画出来
```

接下来自动发生：

1. 主 agent 理解内容类型并调研（arXiv 链接优先精读论文；否则走搜索）
2. 你收到一行摘要：`将生成 N 张图（kind1 + kind2）· 来源：…`
3. 每个视图派一个独立子代理，**并行**生成 `<kind>.html`
4. **浮窗自动弹出**；最终回复里同时给出各视图直链

直链形如（关掉浮窗后依然可用）：

```
http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-facet/<slug>/diagram.html
http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-facet/<slug>/tower.html
```

产物索引页：`http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-facet/`

## 模式与视图

内置模式（主 agent 自动识别选用）：

| 模式 | 视图清单 | 语义配色（节选） |
|---|---|---|
| `model-architecture` 模型架构 | diagram + tower | 注意力橙 / FFN 蓝 / 嵌入紫 / 归一化绿 / 循环·状态藤紫 |
| `rl-training` RL·Agent 训练管线 | flow + timeline | 采样紫 / 奖励橙 / 更新蓝 / 缓冲绿 / 环境藤紫 |
| `red-team` 攻防·红蓝关系 | network + timeline | 攻击橙 / 防守蓝 / 资产紫 / 工具绿 / 边界虚线灰 |
| `workflow` 论文工作流 | flow（单视图示例） | 步骤蓝 / 决策橙 / 输入输出紫 / 循环藤紫 |
| `generic` 通用兜底 | diagram + flow | 自行按语义归类（同类同色），页脚注明映射 |

视图词表（文件名 = `<kind>.html`）：

| kind | 是什么 | 技术 |
|---|---|---|
| `diagram` | 2D 结构/关系图（自上而下分层、重复组 ×N） | 内联 SVG |
| `tower` | 3D 分层堆叠视图 | three.js |
| `network` | 3D 关系网络（力导向） | three.js |
| `flow` | 流程/管线图（含循环回边） | 内联 SVG |
| `timeline` | 时间线（可带泳道） | 内联 SVG |

## 自造模式（OOD 一点点魔法）

内容不属于任何内置模式时：先用 `generic` 兜底；若主 agent 确信值得一个新模式，
它会写一个 ≤50 行的 JSON 到 `$DSH_HOME/facet/modes/<name>.json`：

```json
{ "name": "crypto-protocol", "label": "密码协议",
  "views": ["flow", "timeline"],
  "colors": { "密钥交换": "#1C7ED6", "验证": "#E8590C" } }
```

限制：`views` 只能取自词表、颜色只能用色板、名字小写 kebab——**渲染层封闭、语义层开放**。
保存后本次即按它执行，以后同类内容自动复用（索引页会标出自定义模式）。

## 产物结构

```
$DSH_HOME/facet/<slug>/
├── spec.json      # 通用图结构：nodes / edges / groups + 来源与置信度
├── diagram.html   # 视图文件（文件名 = <kind>.html）
├── tower.html     # …每个视图一个单文件 HTML
└── meta.json      # 生成元数据（query / mode / views / 状态）

$DSH_HOME/facet/modes/<name>.json   # 自造模式（OOD 时生成，可复用）
```

## 配置（可选配置 · 不配置即默认）

**默认开箱即用**，无需任何配置。仅当要改默认值时才需要：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml（示例）
- id: dsh-facet
  config:
    homeDir: ''      # 产物根目录，默认 $DSH_HOME/facet
    readyPing: true  # 产物就绪后推送浮窗事件（默认开）
```

## 工作机制（给好奇的人）

- 命令处理器只做确定性的事：校验参数 → 生成 slug → 建目录写 `meta.json(pending)` → 读取自定义模式 → 把**工作流提示词**（含模式表、视图词表、spec 规范、风格铁律、自造模式规范）以 user 消息注入当前 agent（与官方 `/goal` 同款 `agent.followup` 通路）。
- 智能的事交给 agent：识别内容 → 调研 → 写成通用图结构的 `spec.json` → 用内置 `subagent` 工具**为每个视图并行派发独立子代理**。
- 收尾走 `facet_ready` 工具：校验视图文件 → 写 `meta.views` → SSE 广播（载荷含 `views:[{kind,title,url}]`）→ 界面浮窗弹出；各视图直链同时回给 agent 放进最终回复。
- HTTP 路由（`/dsh-facet/*`）挂在 webServer 上（可选依赖——无 web 服务的几何下插件照常工作，仅少了浮窗与直链）。

## 已知边界

- 浮窗由**实时事件**触发：页面刷新后浮窗不还原（用消息里的直链即可再开）。
- 一次 `/visualize` 的成本 = 1 轮调研 + N 个子代理（N=该模式视图数，1~3），按需触发。
- 3D 视图的 three.js 走 jsdelivr CDN（首次打开需联网）。

## 开发

```sh
npm test       # 仿真测试：122 项断言（命令/提示词/ready/回退链/SSE/路由/词表）
npm run build  # esbuild 编译客户端半区（Termux 用 @esbuild/android-arm64 二进制）
```

## License

MIT

# DeepSeek Harness CLI Delegator

[![CI](https://github.com/twanonymous/agent-dispatch-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/twanonymous/agent-dispatch-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![DeepSeek Harness Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek_Harness-Plugin-4c7dff)](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

[繁體中文](#繁體中文) · [English](#english)

## 繁體中文

> **讓 DeepSeek Harness 成為本機 AI CLI 的總指揮。**

這是一個原生 **DeepSeek Harness Plugin**，讓 DeepSeek 能把簡單、範圍明確或特定領域的工作，自動交給 Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Claude CLI 或其他自訂 CLI，再把結果帶回主對話繼續整合。

### 一行安裝 DeepSeek Harness Plugin

```shell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twanonymous/agent-dispatch-cli/main/plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/dist/dsh-cli-delegator-0.2.0.tgz
```

- 原生 Cordis plugin 與 DSH profile bundle。
- 直接向 DeepSeek Harness 註冊 `list_cli_workers`、`delegate_cli`。
- 自動路由：程式工作給 Codex、研究與摘要給 Gemini、審查與寫作給 Claude。
- 預設唯讀，具備輸出上限、取消機制，任務內容只透過 stdin 傳入。
- 可在設定中加入 Ollama 等其他 CLI provider。

[查看插件原始碼](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/) · [下載插件封裝](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/dist/dsh-cli-delegator-0.2.0.tgz) · [驗證紀錄](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/VERIFICATION.md)

### Codex 與 MCP 版本

Repository 同時保留 Agent Dispatch CLI，供 Codex 與其他 MCP client 使用；主代理仍負責驗證與最終整合。

### 特色

- Codex 原生 Skill 與 MCP 工具。
- 內建 Claude Code、Gemini CLI adapter。
- 可自行新增任意本機 AI CLI。
- 依 `search`、`review`、`summarize` 等能力自動路由。
- 預設使用唯讀模式，不讓受委派服務直接修改主工作區。
- 支援同步委派及背景任務的狀態、結果與取消。
- Windows、macOS、Linux 共用零相依 Node.js 執行層。

### 快速開始

```shell
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs init
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs doctor
```

設定檔位於目前專案的 `.agent-dispatch/config.json`。使用以下指令新增自己的服務：

```shell
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs provider add local-ai --command my-ai --capabilities review,summarize
```

### Codex Plugin

本 repository 已採標準 marketplace 結構；可安裝內容位於
`plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/`。

最快安裝：

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add twanonymous/agent-dispatch-cli --ref main --json
codex plugin add agent-dispatch-cli@agent-dispatch --json
```

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add /你的絕對路徑/agent-dispatch-cli --json
codex plugin add agent-dispatch-cli@agent-dispatch --json
```

安裝後，在任何專案中請 Codex「列出可委派的 AI 服務」即可確認連線。
列出服務與查詢背景結果會自動核准；真正送出任務與取消任務仍會提示。

### 已驗證環境

- Codex CLI 0.147.0
- Claude Code 2.0.54
- Gemini CLI 0.51.0
- Node.js 20、22
- Windows、Ubuntu、macOS CI

完整指令、原始輸出與已知登入限制請見 [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md)。

### 設計原則

其他 CLI 的回答是未驗證建議。Codex 必須自行確認檔案位置、指令、測試與結論，並負責最後修改與交付。內建 Claude Code 與 Gemini CLI adapter 使用各自的 plan／唯讀核准模式；自訂 CLI 則遵循該程式本身的安全界線。

### 授權

MIT


---

## English

> **Make DeepSeek Harness the orchestrator of your local AI CLIs.**

This native **DeepSeek Harness Plugin** gives DeepSeek the ability to route simple, focused, or domain-specific tasks to Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Claude CLI, and custom workers—then bring the result back into the parent conversation.

### Install the DeepSeek Harness Plugin

```shell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twanonymous/agent-dispatch-cli/main/plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/dist/dsh-cli-delegator-0.2.0.tgz
```

- Native Cordis plugin and DSH profile bundle.
- Registers `list_cli_workers` and `delegate_cli` directly in DeepSeek Harness.
- Automatic routing: coding to Codex, research and summaries to Gemini, review and writing to Claude.
- Read-only by default, bounded output, cancellation support, and task content sent through stdin.
- Custom CLI providers supported through configuration.

[View the plugin source](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/) · [Download the package](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/dist/dsh-cli-delegator-0.2.0.tgz) · [Verification](plugins/dsh-cli-delegator/VERIFICATION.md)

### Codex and MCP edition

The repository also includes Agent Dispatch CLI for Codex and other MCP clients. The orchestrating agent selects bounded tasks, delegates them to configured local AI CLIs, and remains responsible for verification and final integration.

### Why

- CLI-first and cross-platform, including native Windows.
- Providers are configured by the user rather than hard-coded.
- Capability-based routing selects an available service.
- Read-only delegation is the default.
- Codex remains responsible for verification and final integration.

### Requirements

- Node.js 20+
- At least one supported or custom AI CLI already installed and authenticated

### Quick start

```shell
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs init
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs doctor
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs run review "Review the current diff" --provider claude
node plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/cli.mjs provider add local-ai --command my-ai --capabilities review,summarize
```

Edit `.agent-dispatch/config.json` to add, disable, or reorder providers.
`doctor` reports whether a CLI is installed; the first delegated task may still
require that provider's own login or workspace-trust setup.

### 60-second Codex install

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add twanonymous/agent-dispatch-cli --ref main --json
codex plugin add agent-dispatch-cli@agent-dispatch --json
```

Then ask Codex:

```text
List the delegated AI services available in this workspace.
Ask an available delegated AI to review the current diff, then verify its findings.
```

### Install as a Codex plugin

For local development, clone this repository, then register its directory:

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add /absolute/path/to/agent-dispatch-cli --json
codex plugin add agent-dispatch-cli@agent-dispatch --json
```

Open Codex in a repository and ask it to list the delegated AI services. The
included Skill teaches Codex which tasks are suitable for delegation and makes
Codex verify every returned claim before it edits or integrates anything.

### Connect to Codex through MCP

Register this command as a stdio MCP server:

```shell
node /absolute/path/to/agent-dispatch-cli/plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/src/mcp.mjs
```

The server exposes:

- `list_ai_services`
- `delegate_task`
- `start_task`
- `task_status`
- `task_result`
- `cancel_task`

Background job records store a SHA-256 digest of the task rather than the
original prompt. Finished provider output is stored under the ignored
`.agent-dispatch/jobs/` directory so it can be inspected after completion.

The repository's `.codex/config.toml` auto-approves only service listing and
stored status/result reads. New delegation and cancellation remain prompted.

The installable Codex plugin lives under `plugins/agent-dispatch-cli/`; the
repository-level marketplace manifest is under `.agents/plugins/`.

### Design boundary for v0.1

Delegated agents receive prompts through stdin and return stdout/stderr. The
built-in Claude Code and Gemini CLI adapters use their plan/read-only approval
modes. Custom providers are user-controlled executables and remain inside that
executable's own trust boundary.

Gemini CLI headless execution requires an authenticated session and a trusted
workspace. Configure those using Gemini CLI itself before delegating a task;
Agent Dispatch does not bypass its workspace-trust check.

### What makes this useful

Agent Dispatch is not a chat relay. Codex remains the orchestrator: it selects a
small capability-labelled task, calls one configured local CLI, treats the
answer as untrusted advice, independently verifies it, and owns the final edit.
The same workflow supports built-in and user-defined providers without coupling
the project to one vendor.

### Compatibility

| Component | Tested | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Codex CLI | 0.147.0 | MCP client and final verifier |
| Claude Code | 2.0.54 | Plan-mode review/reason/plan provider |
| Gemini CLI | 0.51.0 | Plan-mode search/analyze/summarize provider |
| Node.js | 20 and 22 | Zero-dependency runtime |
| OS | Windows, Ubuntu, macOS | CI matrix |

See [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md) for commands, literal outputs, known
provider-login requirements, and package hashes.

### Roadmap

- Worktree-isolated implementation mode
- Cost and duration budgets
- Signed result records and reproducible verification
- Additional provider adapters contributed by the community

###

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bundle-updater

> DSH profile 整合包 · 插件全生命周期管理器（v0.2.1）

**English**: A full-lifecycle plugin manager for DSH profile bundles — update check, search, install, uninstall and security audit for npm / GitHub / local-link plugins. Every write operation is auto-backed up first.

五个工具覆盖插件从发现到维护的完整生命周期：**检查更新 / 搜索 / 安装 / 卸载 / 安全审计**。
吸收社区 dsh-update-radar（link-git 上游检查）与 marketplace（安装管道）的设计思路；
所有写操作（安装 / 卸载 / 更新）前自动备份，可随时回退。

## 工具一览

### 1. `bundle_update` — 检查/更新插件

检查三类依赖：
- **npm 包**：registry 最新版 vs 当前版本
- **GitHub 直链**：上游 HEAD commit vs 固定 commit
- **link-git 插件**（link: 且含 .git）：本地 HEAD vs 上游 HEAD

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `mode` | `check`（默认）只报告；`update` 执行更新（前自动备份） |
| `packages` | 包名子集；缺省全部 |

### 2. `bundle_search` — 搜索社区插件

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `query` | 关键词 |
| `source` | `github`（默认，dsh-plugin topic）或 `npm`（registry） |
| `limit` | 条数上限，默认 10 |

返回名称/描述/star/安装 spec，可直接喂给 `bundle_install`。

### 3. `bundle_install` — 安装插件

`spec` 支持：`npm 包名@版本` / `github:owner/repo#ref` / `link:绝对路径`。
自动加入 `dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles`，安装前备份。

### 4. `bundle_uninstall` — 卸载插件

按包名从 `dependencies` + `bundles` 移除，卸载前备份。

### 5. `bundle_security` — 安全审计

三道防线扫描当前整合包：

- **已知漏洞**：`pnpm audit`（官方 registry）
- **生命周期脚本**：检查所有已装插件的 `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`/`prepare` 等脚本（供应链攻击最常见入口）
- **外发端点**：提取插件代码中的外发网络端点并与白名单比对

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `deep` | `true` 时同时扫描传递依赖（较慢）；缺省只扫直接依赖 |

## 每周提醒（可选）

本插件零被动 token 开销（不在启动时注入内容）。每周提醒用官方
`schedule_create`：

```
schedule_create(every_seconds=604800, prompt="检查 DSH 插件更新：bundle_update(mode=check) 后报告")
```

## 插件配置

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: bundle-updater
  name: dsh-bundle-updater
  config:
    profile: web
    # skip: ["dsh-token-budget"]
```

## 开发

```sh
npm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
npm run build       # esbuild → lib/index.js
```

plugins.description: Hover file paths and URLs in the DSH Web UI to reveal them in Explorer or open them in the default browser.
plugins.readme_text:
# path-click

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web 界面插件：**把鼠标悬停到文件路径或网址上，会弹出一个气泡菜单，一键在「资源管理器」中显示，或用默认浏览器打开**——任何文件类型都能在浏览器里打开，效果等同于把 `file://` 地址粘贴到浏览器地址栏。

🇨🇳 中文 | [🇬🇧 English](README.en.md)

## 功能

- 悬停消息里的文件路径（行内代码、产物 chips、文件提及）→ 气泡菜单：
  - 📁 **在资源管理器中显示**：文件打开其所在文件夹，文件夹直接打开
  - 🌐 **用浏览器打开**：无论什么文件类型，都在默认浏览器中打开（HTML、JS、图片、日志……）
- 悬停网址（http/https/file/mailto 链接）→ 用默认浏览器打开
- 工具调用卡片里的文件路径（含相对工作区的路径）同样支持
- 气泡采用纵向布局，鼠标可以放心从路径移到按钮上，不会中途消失

## 工作原理

插件分两部分，通过一个包同时加载：

| 部分 | 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主端 | `lib/index.js` | 注册 `/path-click` HTTP 路由，执行打开动作；作为 bundle 被 loader 加载 |
| 浏览器端 | `lib/client.js` | 悬停检测与气泡 UI；通过 `dsh.client` 声明被 `dsh-client-modules` 自动发现并注入页面 |

### 打开机制（Windows）

- **资源管理器**：直接 `explorer.exe <路径>`（文件 → 打开其所在文件夹；不依赖 explorer 的 `/select,` 开关，该开关跨进程传递时极不可靠）
- **浏览器（文件路径）**：从注册表 `http\UserChoice` 关联探测**默认浏览器程序**（Chrome / Edge / Firefox 等），把 `file://` URL 作为命令行参数交给它——绕开文件类型关联，所以 `.js`、`.lnk` 等无关联类型也能在浏览器中打开，且不会弹出"选择打开方式"
- **浏览器（http/https）**：同一机制；`mailto:` 走 `rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler`

> 为什么不直接用 ShellExecute / `start`？ShellExecute 对 `file://` 链接会走文件类型关联：HTML 能打开，但 `.js` 这类会弹"选择打开方式"，且 `explorer.exe` 拿到 `file://` 会自己在资源管理器中导航。直接调用浏览器程序是最可控的方案。

### 安全设计

- 路由**不在 `/api` 前缀下**（该前缀由 DSH 的固定路由表把持，第三方插件无法扩展），因此自带信任围栏：
  - 仅接受 `POST` + `application/json`（强制浏览器预检，防跨站请求）
  - `Origin` 必须等于 `http://<Host>`，且 `Host` 必须是回环地址（127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1）——同时防跨站 CSRF 与 DNS rebinding
- 打开动作仅在回环部署（本机访问）下启用
- URL 协议白名单：仅 `http:` / `https:` / `file:` / `mailto:`；拒绝含引号/换行的值
- 路径含 `%` 字符时拒绝用浏览器打开（避免 cmd 环境变量展开问题）
- 浏览器端对所有请求的路径做存在性校验后再调用系统

### 已知问题与设计取舍

- 相对路径（如工具卡片里的 `plugins/foo/bar.js`）按**宿主进程 cwd** 解析；默认部署中 cwd 即工作区根，所以正确；若工作区不是宿主启动目录，相对路径会解析错位
- 路径尾部反斜杠会被剥掉再传给 explorer（`path\"` 会破坏命令行引号解析，导致 explorer 回退打开默认文件夹）
- 思考过程（Think）等**大段纯文本里嵌着的路径**不支持悬停（为避免误匹配，只对"元素内容恰好是路径"的文本生效）
- macOS / Linux 分支（`open -R` / `xdg-open`）已实现但未在真机验证

## 安装

前置：已安装 DSH（`dsh` 命令可用）与 [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/)。

### 从 git 仓库安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:harmony520/path-click
```

### 从本地目录安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/path-click
```

> **Windows 注意**：路径含空格（如用户名 "Mo Haowei"）时，`dsh plugin` 的 pnpm 转发会拆坏参数。可改用直接 pnpm：
>
> ```powershell
> cd %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web
> pnpm add C:\path\to\path-click
> ```
>
> 然后把 `"path-click"` 手动追加到该目录 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表。

安装后**重启 DSH**（关闭控制台窗口，重新启动），浏览器页面按 **F5** 刷新。

> 客户端模块（`lib/client.js`）的改动支持热更新：DSH 每 500ms 轮询一次模块文件，改了保存即可在当前窗口生效，无需重启。宿主端（`lib/index.js`）与包名/配置改动需要重启。

## 使用

1. 打开 DSH Web（默认 http://127.0.0.1:3080）
2. 把鼠标悬停到任意文件路径或网址上
3. 点击气泡里的按钮

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove path-click
```

## 开发与测试

```bash
# 语法检查
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/client.js

# 宿主逻辑单元测试（校验、信任围栏、路径规范化；不会真正打开任何窗口）
node test-host.mjs
```

诊断日志：`%TEMP%\path-click.log`（每次打开动作记录命令与结果，排查问题用）。

## 目录结构

```
path-click/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js      # 宿主端：/path-click 路由、信任围栏、打开逻辑、默认浏览器探测
│   └── client.js     # 浏览器端：悬停检测与气泡工具条（dsh.client 模块）
├── cordis.patch.yml  # bundle patch：注册 loader 行
├── package.json      # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明
├── test-host.mjs     # 宿主逻辑单元测试
└── README.md
```

## 兼容性

- 针对 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 开发
- Windows 为主要目标平台；macOS / Linux 分支存在但未验证
- 依赖浏览器默认关联可读（`reg.exe`），否则回退到 `cmd start` / `rundll32`

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-life — 数字生命循环原语插件

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：数字生命的循环原语——睡眠、状态感知、整点报时。只提供原语，零规则：所有决策（何时睡/睡多久/醒来做什么）归 agent 自主判断。

## 功能特性

- **life_sleep**：可打断的进程内 wait——到期自动自我唤醒；主人消息随时打断（实时事件监听）
- **life_status**：当前时间、安排中的睡眠、守护事故记录（免疫层可见性）
- **整点报时**：时间消息注入上下文**最后面**（同小时零注入，防破坏缓存命中——跨小时自动更新）
- **实时插话**：任何 user 事件立即取消睡眠定时器——消息不用等睡眠结束

## 安装

```bash
cd <你的 self-plugins 目录>
git clone https://github.com/jonah791/dsh-agent-life.git
cd dsh-agent-life
pnpm install
pnpm build
```

## 配置

| 配置项 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|--------|------|--------|
| `incidentPath` | 守护事故文件路径 | — |
| `dataDir` | 决策日志目录 | — |

## 技术要点

- 时间感来自差值：唤醒消息携带「睡了多久 + 期间新增事件数」——无心跳/巡检
- 整点报时通过 `agent/pre-step` waterfall（prepend 最前注册）实现——时间永远在上下文末尾

## 相关

- [我的数字生命爱丽丝 — 插件生态中心（架构总览）](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 智能上下文压缩插件 —— 在有限窗口内管理认知资源，让 Agent 记住真正重要的信息。                 Smart context compression for DSH — managing cognitive resources within limited windows, so your Agent remembers what truly matters.
plugins.readme_text:
# @whatsmore-nf/dsh-context-steward

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 插件：把固定容量的上下文窗口当作稀缺的“认知资源”来做调度——
在硬性 token 预算内优先保障智能体对“当前关键决策”的注意力带宽，按价值密度分级压缩，
对已完成的阶段做记忆巩固，并维护结构化“事实金库”，让被驱逐的源文本仍可被召回。

它以 Cordis `Service` 形态发布，注册为 `ctx.contextSteward`，使用 schemastery 声明
`static Config` 与 `static inject`，与官方 Harness 插件（如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`）保持同一形态。

## 与官方 compaction 的关系

官方 `dsh-compaction-*` 负责压缩“会话正文本身”；本插件是互补层：负责对“注入的记忆”做
认知资源调度——去重聚合、分级压缩、阶段巩固、关键决策带宽保障、事实召回——再把压缩快照
注入模型可见上下文。两者可并存运行。

## 安装

通过 Harness 插件 CLI（与官方插件一致）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @whatsmore-nf/dsh-context-steward@latest
```

或直接通过 npm：

```sh
npm install @whatsmore-nf/dsh-context-steward
```

插件以 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 为 peer 依赖；Harness profile 已自带这些运行时。

## 加载

在 `cordis.yml` / `cordis.patch.yml` 的 bundle 中加入一行：

```yaml
- id: dsh-context-steward
  name: '@whatsmore-nf/dsh-context-steward'
  config:
    capacity: 8000
    enabled: true
    inject: true
```

加载后注册 `ctx.contextSteward` 服务，并自动订阅 Harness 生命周期事件（见[事件](#事件)）。

## 配置（`ContextStewardConfig`）

全部字段可选，缺省时使用下表默认值。未知键、类型错误、越界的比例参数会导致插件加载失败
（`resolveConfig` 严格校验，与官方插件一致）。

| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `capacity` | `4000` | 注入的压缩上下文 token 预算（固定带宽上限）。 |
| `reserved` | `0` | 系统保留 tokens，不计入可压缩区。 |
| `decisionGuarantee` | `floor(capacity × 0.35)` | 关键决策注意力带宽下限：保护决策时工作集最多占用的 tokens。 |
| `halfLifeMs` | `600000` | 时间衰减半衰期（10 分钟）。 |
| `adaptiveRecency` | `true` | 根据决策节奏自适应半衰期。 |
| `minAdaptiveHalfLifeMs` | `10000` | 自适应半衰期下限。 |
| `maxAdaptiveHalfLifeMs` | `3600000` | 自适应半衰期上限。 |
| `adaptiveThresholds` | `true` | 根据抖动自调优升降级阈值。 |
| `churnWindowMs` | `60000` | 阈值自调优的抖动观察窗口。 |
| `tuneStep` | `0.03` | 阈值自调优步长。 |
| `demoteThreshold` | `0.35` | 分数低于此值的工作项降级到冷池。 |
| `promoteThreshold` | `0.55` | 分数高于此值的冷池项提升回工作集。 |
| `workingRenderRatio` | `0.5` | 工作集占渲染预算的比例。 |
| `maxProtectedDecisions` | `4` | 全保真保留的关键决策快照数（超出部分决策老化）。 |
| `coldCompactScore` | `0.4` | 冷池分级压缩的最低分数门槛。 |
| `rehydrateThreshold` | `0.6` | 存档回灌工作集的分数门槛。 |
| `dedupe` | `true` | 重复观测聚合为 `重复×N` 记录。 |
| `consolidate` | `true` | 已完成的阶段巩固为一条结构化摘要。 |
| `renderBudget` | 可用容量 | 渲染注入上下文的 token 上限。 |
| `maxItemChars` | `6000` | 单条 tool/observation 源文本截断上限（完整原文保留在金库）。 |
| `reclaimPeekLimit` | `16` | 价值密度回收的候选窥视条数。 |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` 时只注册服务、不监听事件。 |
| `inject` | `true` | 启用压缩快照注入（仍受 `injectThresholdRatio` 门控）。 |
| `injectThresholdRatio` | `0.8` | 仅当实测会话压力 `totalTokens >= floor(窗口 × 比例)` 时才注入压缩快照——与官方 compaction 的 `thresholdRatio` 触发语义一致；低于阈值时插件只做不可见的内存书签，不干扰正常推理。 |
| `injectContextWindow` | `0` | 上下文窗口显式覆盖（tokens）。`0` = 自动取路由模型适配器上报的 `contextWindow`；解析不到且未覆盖时保守跳过注入。 |

## 使用

### Service 形态（Harness 内）

```ts
import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import ContextSteward from '@whatsmore-nf/dsh-context-steward'

export const name = 'context-steward'
export const inject = ['sessions']

export function apply(ctx: Context): void {
  const plugin = ctx.plugin(ContextSteward, { capacity: 8000 })
  // 可选：接入 LLM 语义摘要（pre-step 空闲期异步预热压缩，压缩质量从启发式升级为结构化摘要）
  // plugin.asyncSummarize = async (content, depth) => await llm.complete(
  //   buildCompactionPrompt({ context: [content] }), { maxTokens: depth >= 3 ? 160 : 80 },
  // )
}
```

服务以 `ctx.contextSteward` 暴露；按会话取独立调度器：
`ctx.contextSteward.scheduler(session)`。

### standalone 形态（演示 / 单测，无需 Harness 运行时）

```ts
import { createContextStewardPlugin } from '@whatsmore-nf/dsh-context-steward'

const plugin = createContextStewardPlugin({ capacity: 8000 })
plugin.hooks.onAppend?.({ id: 'u1', kind: 'user', content: '目标是部署服务', timestamp: 0 })
plugin.hooks.onDecision?.({ goal: '部署服务', currentStep: '选型', attentionFocus: ['部署', '服务'] })
const prompt = plugin.hooks.onBeforePrompt?.() // 注入压缩后的上下文
```

### 调度器核心

`CognitiveResourceScheduler` 独立导出：`ingest()`、`checkpoint()`、`setPhase()`、
`consolidatePhase()`、`compiledContext()`、`query()`、`exportArchive()`、
`exportState()` / `restoreState()` —— 完整签名见类型声明。

## 事件

`enabled` 为 `true` 时订阅：

| 事件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `session/event` | 把模型可见的 user/assistant/tool 事件接入调度器（去重、分级压缩、事实抽取、带宽记账）。跳过本插件自注入的压缩上下文。 |
| `agent/pre-step` | 把即将进行的步骤视为关键决策：注意力重排，然后注入压缩快照。 |
| `agent/request-error` | `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 失败时把超窗作为 observation 喂给调度器，让下一轮快照感知到失败。 |
| `agent/disposed` | 导出存档、打印收尾指标并释放会话状态。 |

## License

MIT

# 办公室农民微信表情插件（dsh-plugin-office-farmer）

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 自定义工具插件：怀旧农具专辑「农忙打工人」+ 新农具表情制作流水线。

内置两个工具：

## generate_sticker — 微信表情专辑「农忙打工人」（风格模板）

16 张农具主题原创表情（锄头摸鱼、镰刀割韭菜、水桶跑路……），240×240 透明底投稿成品打包进插件。
**本工具的 16 张成品即为 `craft_sticker` 制作新农具表情的风格模板参考**——制作新农具前可先用本工具查看已有成品的风格与排版。

- 按 `id`（tool_01~16）/ `keyword`（摸鱼、割韭菜、压力大、退退退、上进、捞一把、缓一缓、带上我、好运来、跑路、打气、稳住、勿扰、果断、暴击、解气）/ 农具名选取
- `caption` 自定义底部梗文字（与投稿管线同款楷体红字白描边，基于逐像素一致的无文字素材重绘）
- `animated: true` → 透明底 GIF 动图（bounce / wiggle / shake / blink）

```
generate_sticker(
  id?:      'tool_01'~'tool_16',
  keyword?: '摸鱼'|'割韭菜'|'压力大'|'退退退'|'上进'|'捞一把'|'缓一缓'|'带上我'|'好运来'|'跑路'|'打气'|'稳住'|'勿扰'|'果断'|'暴击'|'解气',
  caption?: 自定义梗文字（默认保留专辑原文字）,
  animated?: true → 透明底 GIF,
  motion?:  'bounce'|'wiggle'|'shake'|'blink',
  size?:    默认 240
)
```

## craft_sticker — 新农具表情制作流水线

输入任意农具名，走「农忙打工人」同款搪瓷缸怀旧风流水线，产出 240×240 透明底投稿规格成品。**两阶段调用**（图片生成由 harness 的 Agent 用自身图片能力完成，插件负责其余全部确定性步骤）：

```
阶段一（备料）:
craft_sticker(tool: '背篓', text: '背着KPI')
→ { refPath: 结构参考图, styleAnchorPath: 风格锚点, imagePrompt: 图生图提示词, specPath: 制作单 }

Agent 用图片生成工具按图生图生成白底农具图（参考图依次为 refPath、styleAnchorPath，提示词用 imagePrompt）

阶段二（成品）:
craft_sticker(imagePath: '生成图路径', specPath: '阶段一返回的 specPath')
→ { path: 240×240 透明底 PNG, report: 投稿规格自检 }
```

- 农具目录 24 件（16 专辑件 + 背篓/箩筐/风谷车/碌碡/耧车/辘轳/竹筛/水车），目录内自动出结构参考图；目录外农具传 `structure` 结构描述即可
- `text` 梗文字（≤10 字）、`meaning` 含义词（≤4 字，微信投稿要求）自动兜底
- 后期与投稿管线 `sticker-album/scripts/process.mjs` 同款几何：flood-fill 抠图 → 168px 贴底定位 → 楷体红字白描边 → 240×240 透明底 + 规格自检（尺寸/透明/≤500KB/红字渲染）

---

## 使用步骤：用模板制作新农具表情

以下演示用户输入新农具「石碾」时的完整流程，Agent 依次调用两个工具：

### 第 1 步：用 generate_sticker 查看风格模板

制作新农具前，先选取 1~2 张专辑成品作为风格参考，确认搪瓷缸怀旧风的视觉调性与排版位置。

```
generate_sticker(keyword: '摸鱼')   → 锄头·摸鱼（tool_01）
generate_sticker(keyword: '退退退') → 簸箕·退退退（tool_04）
```

产出：240×240 透明底 PNG，供 Agent 理解「农具居中偏上、底部楷体红字白描边、搪瓷缸质感」的风格标准。

### 第 2 步：craft_sticker 阶段一 — 备料

传入新农具名与梗文字。目录内 24 件自动出结构参考图；目录外农具需额外传 `structure`。

**目录内农具**（如背篓、箩筐、风谷车……）：

```
craft_sticker(tool: '背篓', text: '背着KPI')
→ refPath:          结构参考图 512×512（SVG 栅格化，白底线稿标注部件）
  styleAnchorPath:  风格锚点图（锄头定版原图，搪瓷缸质感锚定）
  imagePrompt:      图生图提示词（含风格关键词 + 农具名 + 结构描述）
  specPath:         制作单 spec.json（阶段二回传）
```

**目录外农具**（如石碾）：

```
craft_sticker(
  tool: '石碾',
  structure: '石制圆盘碾轮，中心立轴，上装木推架，用于碾谷去壳',
  text: '慢慢碾'
)
→ 同上四件产出；imagePrompt 会包含用户提供的结构描述
```

### 第 3 步：Agent 图生图生成白底农具图

Agent 使用自身的图片生成能力，按**图生图**方式生成一张白底农具图：

- 参考图 1：`refPath`（结构参考图 — 保证农具结构正确）
- 参考图 2：`styleAnchorPath`（风格锚点 — 保证搪瓷缸质感一致）
- 提示词：`imagePrompt`（阶段一返回）
- 要求：白底、农具居中、正面视角、无文字

将生成图保存到本地，拿到路径。

### 第 4 步：craft_sticker 阶段二 — 成品化

传入生成图路径与阶段一的 specPath，插件自动完成全部后期：

```
craft_sticker(
  imagePath: '/path/to/生成图.jpg',
  specPath:  '/path/to/spec.json'    // 阶段一返回，自动带出农具名/梗字/含义词
)
→ path:   240×240 透明底 PNG（投稿规格成品）
  report: ['PASS 尺寸 240×240', 'PASS 透明底', 'PASS ≤500KB', 'PASS 楷体红字已渲染']
```

后期管线自动执行：flood-fill 白底抠图 → 168px 贴底居中定位 → 楷体红字白描边渲染 → 240×240 透明底导出 → 规格自检。同名输入得到几何一致的可投稿成品。

### 完整流程示意

```
用户：「帮我做一张石碾表情，配"慢慢碾"」
  │
  ├─ ① generate_sticker(keyword: '摸鱼')     ← 查看风格模板
  │     → 锄头·摸鱼 240×240 透明底 PNG
  │
  ├─ ② craft_sticker(tool: '石碾', structure: '...', text: '慢慢碾')  ← 阶段一备料
  │     → refPath + styleAnchorPath + imagePrompt + specPath
  │
  ├─ ③ Agent 图生图（refPath + styleAnchorPath + imagePrompt）         ← 生成白底图
  │     → /workspace/memes/gen_石碾.jpg
  │
  └─ ④ craft_sticker(imagePath: '...', specPath: '...')               ← 阶段二成品
        → 240×240 透明底 PNG + 自检全 PASS
```

---

## 安装到 DSH profile

```bash
# 1. 安装（pnpm 转发）
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugin-office-farmer

# 2. 在 $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml 注册
# - insert:
#     - id: dsh-plugin-office-farmer
#       name: 'dsh-plugin-office-farmer'

# 3. 重启
dsh web
```

## 兼容版本

| 依赖 | 版本 |
|------|------|
| Node.js | >= 18（sharp 依赖要求） |
| @deepseek-ai/cordis | ^4.0.1 |
| @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools | ^0.1.0-rc.6 |
| 插件版本 | 0.2.0 |

## 开发

```bash
npm install          # sharp + gifenc（如遇 ~/.npm 权限问题：--cache ./.npm-cache）
node test.mjs        # 冒烟测试（专辑/craft 流水线，44 项）
node scripts/build-cutouts.mjs        # 从 sticker-album/raw 重建无文字素材并验证逐像素一致
node scripts/build-style-anchor.mjs   # 从 sticker-album/raw/hoe_c1.jpg 重建风格锚点
```

## 目录结构

```
lib/
  index.js      插件入口：注册两个工具
  album.js      generate_sticker 专辑引擎（成品/换字/GIF）
  craft.js      craft_sticker 制作流水线（参考图/提示词/抠图/成品/自检）
  catalog.js    24 件农具目录（结构 SVG + 结构描述 + 示例梗）
assets/
  album/        16 张投稿成品 + 无文字素材 cutouts/
  style-anchor/ 图生图风格锚点（锄头定版原图）
```

## 技术要点

- 插件 = Cordis 插件（`apply(ctx)` 导出）+ `ctx.tools.register(defineTool({...}))`，需声明规范化 `output { schema, render }`
- 渲染管线：SVG 帧 → sharp 栅格化 → gifenc 编码 GIF（透明底：调色板索引 0 保留为透明色）
- 文字替换几何：工具内容与文字区严格分离（`sticker-album/scripts/process.mjs` 设计约束），无文字素材与投稿成品逐像素一致
- craft 两阶段设计：图片生成为非确定性步骤、由 Agent 执行；参考图渲染/抠图/排版/自检全部确定性、由插件执行——同名输入得到几何一致的可投稿成品

# @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro

[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DeepSeek Harness **Settings Pro** plugin — one package, five features: **IM Bridge**, **Usage**, **Memory**, **Pets**, and **Vision**.

## Quick start

1. Install the package into the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro
```

`<name>` is the profile name (`web` for the Web GUI profile); the command forwards to pnpm in the profile directory.

2. Mount the plugin in `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-settings-pro
      name: '@kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro'
      config: {}
```

3. Restart DSH so the new plugin loads.

4. Open the Web GUI → **Settings Pro**, and flip on whatever you want — all together, a few, or one at a time. Everything is off by default, so nothing runs until you opt in, and every toggle is live (no restart).

## Install & enable with one prompt

This replaces the whole [Quick start](#quick-start) above — you do **not** need to do those steps first. DSH's agent has file access, so just paste one prompt and it does both install and enable for you. Replace the `[...]` list with the features you want:

Usage and Memory are optional and off by default, so you can leave them out of the list entirely — only the features you name get enabled.

```text
Install the @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro plugin into this DSH profile and enable these features: [usage, memory, pets, vision, telegram, wechat]. Keep anything I didn't list disabled.

1. Install the package: run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro` (or `pnpm add @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro` in the profile directory).
2. Add an `insert` entry for plugin id `dsh-settings-pro` (name `@kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro`) to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, and in its `config` turn on only the features I named:
   - usage    → `usageEnabled: true`
   - memory   → `memoryEnabled: true`
   - pets     → `petsEnabled: true`
   - vision   → `visionEnabled: true` (plus `visionBaseUrl`, `visionModel`, `visionApiKeyEnv` — ask me for these if I didn't give them)
   - telegram → `telegramEnabled: true` (plus `telegramBotToken`, `telegramAllowedUserIds` — ask me for these if I didn't give them)
   - wechat   → `wechatEnabled: true`
3. Restart DSH so the new plugin loads.
```

The agent installs the package, writes the patch, sets exactly the `*Enabled` keys you named, and leaves everything else off. After a restart the features run; from then on you can still flip any toggle live in **Settings Pro**.

### Recommended minimal config

Don't want to pick? Paste this ready-to-use version — it enables the self-contained core (**Usage**, **Memory**, **Pets**; all three are optional and off by default) and keeps **IM** (Telegram/WeChat) and **Vision** off, since they need extra tokens/endpoints and default to `false` / empty:

```text
Install the @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro plugin into this DSH profile with the recommended minimal config: enable usage, memory, and pets; keep telegram, wechat, and vision disabled.

1. Install the package: run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro` (or `pnpm add @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro` in the profile directory).
2. Add an `insert` entry for plugin id `dsh-settings-pro` (name `@kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro`) to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, and in its `config` set `usageEnabled: true`, `memoryEnabled: true`, and `petsEnabled: true`. Leave `telegramEnabled`, `wechatEnabled`, and `visionEnabled` unset so they stay `false` (vision's `visionBaseUrl` / `visionModel` / `visionApiKeyEnv` stay empty).
3. Restart DSH so the new plugin loads.
```

You can enable IM or Vision later from **Settings Pro** — they stay off (`false` / empty) until then. Usage and Memory work the same way: they're optional and default to off, and a pets-only setup just needs `petsEnabled: true` in the config.

## Features

| Feature | What it does | How to enable |
|---|---|---|
| **Usage** | DeepSeek balance + official billed daily cost/tokens (peak/off-peak pricing) | Settings Pro → **Usage** → toggle |
| **Memory** | Cross-restart memory + `read_memory` / `write_memory` tools | Settings Pro → **Memory** → toggle |
| **Pets** | Desktop pet that follows conversations | Settings Pro → **Pets** → toggle |
| **Vision** | Describe images via any OpenAI-compatible VLM before a text-only model sees them | Settings Pro → **Vision** → enable + pick model |
| **IM Bridge** | Telegram & WeChat bridge (built-in) | Settings Pro → **IM Bridge** → token / QR |

The `*Enabled` config keys (`usageEnabled`, `memoryEnabled`, `petsEnabled`, `visionEnabled`, `telegramEnabled`, `wechatEnabled`) also work as install-time defaults if you want to pre-enable something for a profile.

## Desktop pet app (optional, Electron)

The "browser" open mode needs no install — it opens `/pet` in a browser tab. For a real always-on-top, draggable floating pet window that clicks back to DSH, use "App" mode: open **Settings Pro → Pets**, hit **Install** in the **Desktop app** card, and the plugin installs Electron locally and launches the pet window. Install state persists, so reopening settings still shows **Running / Installed** etc.

Prefer manual? Run the source repo's `pet-desktop/`: `cd pet-desktop && npm install && npm start`.

Optional env vars (defaults shown):

- `DSH_PET_URL` — pet page URL, default `http://127.0.0.1:3080/pet`
- `DSH_URL` — DSH URL opened on pet click, default `http://127.0.0.1:3080`
- `DSH_OPEN_MODE` — how the pet opens DSH on click: `browser` (default) or `app`
- `DSH_APP_NAME` — macOS Chrome PWA app name for the "app" open mode, default `DeepSeek Harness`

## Notes

- **Updates:** Settings Pro checks the npm registry once a day (at startup and when the settings section opens, reusing a 24h cache). When a newer version exists, a **NEW** chip appears on the **Settings Pro** nav item; the **About** tab (last tab) shows plugin info, the installed/latest versions, a manual **Check for updates** action, and — only when an update exists on a registry install — an **Update & Restart** button (runs `pnpm add @kazecreator/dsh-settings-pro@latest` in the profile and relaunches the dsh process). If the plugin is installed as a `file:` link (local development checkout), the update button is hidden and the About tab shows the install mode as **Local dev (file:)**.
- **Usage auto-sync reads a Chromium browser session** (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Arc / Opera on macOS / Windows / Linux) to backfill official billed usage. Firefox / Safari aren't supported.
- **Pet desktop app is not bundled.** The default "browser" open mode opens `/pet` in a browser tab with no extra install. The "app" mode uses the one-click **Install** button in **Settings Pro → Pets → Desktop app**, which installs and launches the Electron pet window locally with persistent state. You can also run the source repo's `pet-desktop/` manually (`npm install && npm start`).
- **The online pet library fetches from GitHub** — the [Awesome Codex Pet](https://codexpet.top) community gallery by [@legeling](https://github.com/legeling/awesome-codex-pet). Thanks to that project and every pet author for the open submissions. It caches locally and degrades to the cache/offline notice on network failure.
